latest_release.name: v0.8.0
latest_release.body:
Servo v0.8.0 is ready, containing all the changes from October. 

## Trying out the Servo Tech Demo

[troubleshooting guide]: https://servo.org/download/#troubleshooting

### Linux

If you see an error `loading shared libraries` when starting servo on Linux, please refer to the [troubleshooting guide].

### HarmonyOS

Please note that the `servo-aarch64-linux-ohos.hap` attached here is signed for OpenHarmony, not HarmonyOS.
For HarmonyOS self-signing is currently required - You can download the `servo-aarch64-linux-ohos.so` shared library and use DevEco Studio to follow the instructions in the ArkTS [Servo Demo repository](https://github.com/jschwe/ServoDemo)

## What's Changed

This section will be updated with a link to the October blog-post once it is released with a curated overview over the recent changes.
For now you can view the generated release notes below.

<details>
  <summary>Generated Release notes</summary>

## What's Changed
* android: Remove `SurfaceHolderCallback` dependence on `ServoView` by @veyndan in https://github.com/servo/servo/pull/48544
* android: Replace deprecated `onActivityResult` with Activity Result API by @veyndan in https://github.com/servo/servo/pull/48518
* script: fix the borrow hazard panics in KeyframeEffect::GetKeyframes by @MohamedAli00949 in https://github.com/servo/servo/pull/48546
* Enable container timing in WPT by @jasonwilliams in https://github.com/servo/servo/pull/48290
* script: Reduce alloc when checking if element is nonceable by @yezhizhen in https://github.com/servo/servo/pull/48549
* script: Move `handle_mousedown_event` from `VirtualMethods` to `EditingContext` by @SimonSapin in https://github.com/servo/servo/pull/48497
* script_bindings: Enforce no_gc for lifetime of byte array in DOMString calls by @Narfinger in https://github.com/servo/servo/pull/48251
* script: Rename traverse_preorder_non_rooting to traverse_preorder_unrooted by @Narfinger in https://github.com/servo/servo/pull/48555
* layout: Simplify implementation of `box-decoration-break: clone` by @mrobinson in https://github.com/servo/servo/pull/48559
* script: Preallocate timer array by @Narfinger in https://github.com/servo/servo/pull/48558
* webgl: Validate internalformat in getInternalformatParameter by @mxmgorin in https://github.com/servo/servo/pull/48560
* script: Ensure unminified script source outlives JS compilation. by @jdm in https://github.com/servo/servo/pull/48567
* Avoid cloning namespace prefixes during namespace lookup by @Taym95 in https://github.com/servo/servo/pull/48568
* Fix/devtools object prototype by @sahilnyk in https://github.com/servo/servo/pull/48208
* base: Switch from Box::leak to Box::into_raw by @Narfinger in https://github.com/servo/servo/pull/48563
* encoding: switch to explicit dom string replacement in text encoder by @gterzian in https://github.com/servo/servo/pull/48183
* layout: Alter ratio_from_view_box to allow fractional values by @leowatts in https://github.com/servo/servo/pull/48556
* android: Move URI loading to `ServoNavigator` by @veyndan in https://github.com/servo/servo/pull/48573
* android: Move `FrameCallback` where needed by @veyndan in https://github.com/servo/servo/pull/48574
* script: Introduce helper trait for creating UA Shadow roots by @TimvdLippe in https://github.com/servo/servo/pull/48572
* wpt: Enable web animations for `touch-events` by @yezhizhen in https://github.com/servo/servo/pull/48557
* webdriver: Remove redundant invalidation check by @yezhizhen in https://github.com/servo/servo/pull/48566
* svg: add the data model by @mu-mostafa98 in https://github.com/servo/servo/pull/48467
* media-audio: Implement DelayNode interface (no cycle handling) by @kevlu93 in https://github.com/servo/servo/pull/47957
* webgl: Fix clippy warning by @shubhamg13 in https://github.com/servo/servo/pull/47853
* webgl: Initialize framebuffers before blitFramebuffer by @mxmgorin in https://github.com/servo/servo/pull/485
